propositions: push-triggered CI on main is cancelled when commits land close together, rendering healthy main as red on GitHub despite passing pre-merge Gerrit gate
scheduled-only main health runs (6-hourly at staggered off-hour minutes) replace per-commit push triggers to eliminate cancellations by construction rather than hiding them

green scheduled runs publish their own SHA as last-known-green to GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY; red runs publish a copy-pasteable git bisect recipe with both bad and good SHAs pre-filled for multi-commit regression bisection
every touched workflow must explicitly exclude main from push triggers (via branches-ignore) or drop push entirely; non-main branch-push CI is preserved
workflow_dispatch remains or is added to every main-health workflow to enable on-demand health checks independent of schedule
pre-merge Gerrit Verified gate and untouchable workflows (gerrit-verify.yaml, reconcilers, external-integration.yml) are byte-identical; safety property depends on no change to patchset-level gating
